meta.description: Scenario-to-architecture templates used by the architecture generator.

templates.title: MCP Runtime Security Gateway
templates.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  User-->AgentRuntime[Agent Runtime]
  AgentRuntime-->PEP[MCP Gateway / PEP]
  PEP-->Validator[Tool Descriptor Validator]
  PEP-->PDP[Policy Decision Point]
  PDP-->Creds[Ephemeral Credential Broker]
  PEP-->Sandbox[Sandboxed Tool Runtime]
  Sandbox-->API[External APIs / Tools]
  PEP-->Audit[Audit / OTel / SIEM]

templates.title: Agentic Red Team Evaluation Pipeline
templates.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Library[Attack Scenario Library]-->Orchestrator[Attack Orchestrator]
  Orchestrator-->Harness[Target Agent Harness]
  Harness-->Evaluator[Evaluator]
  Evaluator-->Evidence[Evidence Store]
  Evidence-->Gate[CI/CD Quality Gate]

templates.title: Enterprise Agent Governance Control Plane
templates.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  Registry[Agent Registry]-->Cards[Capability Cards]
  Cards-->Policy[Policy Registry]
  Policy-->Broker[NHI / Token Broker]
  Registry-->Trust[A2A Trust Graph]
  Trust-->Telemetry[Telemetry Lake]
  Telemetry-->Dash[Governance Dashboard]

templates.title: Secure Coding Agent Sandbox
templates.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Dev[Developer]-->Agent[Coding Agent]
  Agent-->Gate[Pre-execution Policy Gate]
  Gate-->Pkg[Package Provenance Scanner]
  Gate-->Work[Ephemeral Workspace]
  Work-->Proxy[Network Egress Proxy]
  Gate-->HITL[Human Approval]
  Work-->Audit[Diff / Audit Log]
